Anders Thøgersen (facelift) | drivetrain = MHEV }} The '''BMW X7''' is a [[Full-size car|full-size]] [[Luxury_car|luxury crossover sport utility vehicle]] manufactured by [[BMW]]. It is BMW's largest and second most expensive SUV in its line-up, and is considered a flagship SUV for the brand, and borrows design cues from the 6th and 7th generations of the [[BMW 7 Series]].{{Cite web|date=February 24, 2020|title=BMW X7 Prices, Reviews, and Pictures {{!}} Edmunds|url=https://www.edmunds.com/bmw/x7/|website=[[Edmunds.com]]}}__TOC__The X7 was first announced by BMW in March 2014.{{cite web|title=BMW X7 4x4 confirmed|url=http://www.autoexpress.co.uk/bmw/86389/bmw-x7-4x4-confirmed|website=Auto Express|access-date=28 February 2015|date=28 March 2014}} It was officially unveiled on October 17, 2018, with pre-orders being taken online. The X7 has been available at dealers since March 2019.{{cite web |title=2019 BMW X7 flagship SUV officially revealed |url=https://www.autoblog.com/2018/10/16/2019-bmw-x7-three-row-crossover-revealed-9102wmb/ |website=www.autoblog.com |date=16 October 2018 |access-date=22 June 2020 |language=en}} == Launch and development == BMW provided a preview of the upcoming X7 with the showing of the Concept X7 iPerformance at the 2017 [[International Motor Show Germany|International Motor Show]] in [[Frankfurt]].{{cite magazine |last=Stiler |first=Steve |magazine=Car and Driver |publisher=Hearst Communications |url=https://www.caranddriver.com/news/bmw-concept-x7-iperformance-photos-and-info-news |title=BMW Concept X7 iPerformance – BMW's upcoming über-ute begins to take shape |date=September 2017 |access-date=2018-01-30}} Production of the X7 started in 2018 at the [[BMW US Manufacturing Company]] plant in [[Greer, South Carolina]]. The X7 is built on the same [[BMW CLAR platform]] as the [[BMW X5 (G05)|G05 X5]], however the X7 is taller and wider plus it has been stretched for increased cargo space and third row seating which is standard and more spacious for adults (the X5's third row seating, which is optional, is mainly for children).{{cite web |url=http://www.autoblog.com/2014/03/28/bmw-x7-spartanburg-production-official/ |title=BMW makes X7 in Spartanburg official |last=Turkus |first=Brandon |date=28 March 2014 |website=autoblog.com |access-date=2018-05-23}} In contrast to the X5, it is not available with rear-wheel drive, instead using an all-wheel drive (''xDrive'') drivetrain for all models. In Europe, diesel and petrol engines are available, while the choice is limited to inline-6 and V8 petrol engines in the United States.{{cite web|url=http://www.suvtests.com/bmw/x7/2019/specs/|title=2019 BMW X7 Specs|website=SUVTests.com|access-date=9 January 2020|archive-date=27 March 2022|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220327072848/http://www.suvtests.com/bmw/x7/2019/specs/|url-status=dead}} The G07 features a [[self-levelling suspension|self-levelling]] [[air suspension]] system, with a [[double-wishbone suspension|double-wishbone]] front suspension and [[multi-link suspension|multi-link]] rear suspension.{{Cite web|url=https://www.roadandtrack.com/new-cars/a23844742/2019-bmw-x7-reveal-photos-info-msrp/|title=2019 BMW X7: It's Big, Which Is Also the Title of a 1980s Tom Hanks Movie|last=Perkins|first=Chris|date=2018-10-16|website=Road & Track|language=en-US|access-date=2018-10-19}} It can be raised or lowered by {{convert|40|mm|in|1|abbr=on}} and will automatically lower the car by {{convert|20|mm|in|1|abbr=on}} at speeds of over {{convert|138|kph|mph|abbr=on}}.{{Cite web|url=https://www.carwow.co.uk/bmw/news/2851/bmw-x7-price-specs-release-date|title=2018-19 BMW X7 price, specs and release date {{!}} carwow|website=carwow.co.uk|language=en|access-date=2018-10-19}} The boot capacity is rated at {{convert|326|L|cuft}}, and {{convert|2120|L|cuft}} with the seats folded down.{{Cite web|url=https://www.driving.co.uk/news/new-cars/2019-bmw-x7-date-prices-images-details/|title=2019 BMW X7: On sale date, prices, images and details|date=2018-10-18|website=Sunday 2022, BMW unveiled a new revised X7, which entered production in July and was launched the following month. The design is very similar to the original first generation design, with minimal changes to the side profile and rear. The major changes are a heavily revised front end design premiering new "horizontally split headlight units" and a revised curved widescreen focused dashboard within an otherwise largely unchanged interior. It is widely thought that the aesthetic function of the horizontally split headlights is to increase the proportion of the front design dedicated to the headlights relative to a very large kidney grill. The new headlights were also featured on the [[BMW 7 Series (G70)|new 7 Series and i7]].{{cite news |last=Lye |first=Gerard |date=13 April 2022 |title=2023 BMW X7 facelift – G07 LCI gets split headlights, illuminated grille, 23-inch wheels, mild hybrid engines |url= https://paultan.org/2022/04/13/2023-bmw-x7-facelift-g07-lci-gets-split-headlights-illuminated-grille-23-inch-wheels-mild-hybrid-engines/ |website=Paultan.org |publisher= Driver Communications |location=Malaysia |access-date=14 June 2022}} The revision also includes all vehicles having an [[Mild hybrid|MHEV]] powertrain.{{Cite web |date=2022-04-13 |title=2023 BMW X7 facelift - G07 LCI gets split headlights, illuminated grille, 23-inch wheels, mild hybrid engines - paultan.org |url=https://paultan.org/2022/04/13/2023-bmw-x7-facelift-g07-lci-gets-split-headlights-illuminated-grille-23-inch-wheels-mild-hybrid-engines/ |access-date=2024-08-20 |website=Paul Tan's Automotive News |language=en-US}} File:BMW_G07_LCI_X7_Design_Pure_Excellence_Skyscraper_Grey_Metallic_(5).jpg|2022 BMW X7 File:BMW_X7_xDrive40d_M_Sport_(3CA-22EN30)_front.jpg|2022 BMW X7 with M Sport Package File:BMW G07 (2022) 1X7A7268.jpg|2022 BMW X7 File:BMW_G07_X7_M60i_DSC_8564.jpg|2022 BMW X7 M60i xDrive File:Alpina XB7 (facelift) DSC 0542.jpg|Alpina XB7 (facelift) File:2025 BMW X7 M60i Interior.jpg|Interior (facelift) == Equipment == The G07 X7 is available in Design Pure Excellence, Sport and M Sport trims.{{Cite web|url=https://www.slashgear.com/the-2019-bmw-x7-is-big-brash-and-full-of-the-latest-tech-16550321/|title=The 2019 BMW X7 is big, brash, and full of the latest tech|date=2018-10-16|website=SlashGear|language=en-US|access-date=2018-10-19}} Standard equipment includes Vernasca leather, four-zone [[HVAC|climate control]], [[iDrive]] 7.0, Adaptive LED headlights, [[inductive charging|wireless charging]],{{Cite web|url=https://www.autocar.co.nz/autocar-news-app/bmw-reveals-seven-seat-x7-suv|title=BMW reveals seven-seat X7 SUV|website=www.autocar.co.nz|language=en|access-date=2018-10-19|archive-date=2018-12-09|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181209165441/https://www.autocar.co.nz/autocar-news-app/bmw-reveals-seven-seat-x7-suv|url-status=dead}} and electrically adjustable and heated three row seating. The middle row features three seats with a two-seat configuration also available.{{Cite web|url=https://newatlas.com/2019-bmw-x7-biggest/56818/|title=BMW debuts gigantic new X7 SUV, a study in intelligent, adaptive luxury|website=newatlas.com|date=17 October 2018|language=en|access-date=2018-10-19}} The X7 also receives [[advanced driver-assistance systems|driver assistance systems]] including [[autonomous cruise control system|autonomous cruise control]] and [[collision detection]] with braking intervention.{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnet.com/roadshow/news/2019-bmw-x7-suv-debut/|title=2019 BMW X7 is a three-row SUV crammed to the brim with tech|last=Krok|first=Andrew|website=Roadshow|language=en|access-date=2018-10-19}} Other options include cooled and heated cup holders, a panoramic sunroof with LED light patterns, and laser headlights.{{Cite web|url=https://www.motor1.com/news/283231/most-expensive-bmw-x7/|title=Most Expensive 2019 BMW X7 Costs $122,425|last=X7|first=Bmw|website=Motor1.com|language=en|access-date=2018-12-04}} An off-road package adds selectable off-road driving modes and adjusts the ride height, acceleration and transmission response, and [[traction control system]].{{Cite web|url=https://autoweek.com/article/luxury/three-rows-all-2019-bmw-x7-joins-full-size-luxury-fray|title=Official: This is the 2019 BMW X7 full-size SUV|website=Autoweek|date=16 October 2018|access-date=2018-10-19}} The instrument cluster features a camera to ensure the driver is paying attention to the road while autonomous functions are active,{{Cite web|url=https://www.cars.com/articles/ok-2019-bmw-x7-you-have-our-attention-1420703199283/|title=OK, 2019 BMW X7, You Have Our Attention|date=2018-10-16|website=www.cars.com|access-date=2018-10-18}} and allows the driver to take their hands off the steering wheel for up to one minute. Additionally it has an optional heads up display that shows a clear map with navigation instructions, in addition to speed.{{cite web| url = https://www.motortrend.com/news/2019-bmw-x7-10-cool-features-new-luxury-suv/| title = 2019 BMW X7: 10 Cool Features on BMW's New Luxury SUV| publisher=Motor Trend|date = 28 March 2019|quote=... a clear map with navigation instructions that almost make looking at the infotainment screen unnecessary.}} 30-40 models with the M Sport trim and M50 models can be fitted with M Performance Parts. ==Production== In March 2025, [[Avtotor]] resumed assembly of the X5, X6, and X7 models using remaining component kits left over after BMW terminated its partnership with the company in 2022 following [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russia's invasion of Ukraine]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.carscoops.com/2026/07/russia-bootleg-bmw-production/|title=Russia Is Selling Bootleg BMWs Built With Leftover Parts From $153,000|first=Stephen|last=Rivers|date=July 2, 2026}} BMW stated that it was not involved in the production, explaining that Avtotor was assembling limited batches of vehicles from "old, partially outdated kits" that had remained in its possession after the partnership ended, with production taking place on an irregular basis.{{Cite web|url=https://www.rferl.org/a/bmw-russia-unlicensed-production-kaliningrad-luxury-sanctions/33794826.html|title=Bootleg BMWs: How Luxury Cars Are Built From Leftover Parts In Russia|first1=Amos|last1=Chapple|first2=Mark|last2=Krutov|date=July 2, 2026|via=www.rferl.org}} Avtotor sold a total of 145 vehicles in 2025.{{Cite web|url=https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8443492|title=Разгон с запасом|date=February 20, 2026|website=Коммерсантъ}} Although these vehicles were registered as 2025 and 2026 model-year vehicles, they retained the exterior design of the pre-facelift 2022 models.
